title: Sips & Sights Willamette River Cruise (Wine Tasting included!)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
We only serve alcoholic drinks for passengers 21 years old and above, IDs will be checked for all passengers. Passengers below 21 years old will be served non-alcoholic drinks only.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Our Sips and Sights cruises partner with local wineries for special tastings onboard! Enjoy a flight of three 1-ounce wine tastings while a winery representative shares a little about the featured wines. A small snack is also included.

Additional drinks and snacks will be available for purchase from our onboard bar throughout the cruise. Alcohol tasting is for guests age 21+ with valid ID. 

What makes this tour special is its thoughtful mix of guided narration and time to simply relax, take in the scenery, capture memories, enjoy refreshments, and experience the natural beauty surrounding you.

Seats are limited—reserve today to sail, sip, and see the sights in unforgettable island style!
